title: VTC Events — Show — payload
description: Read one event the caller may see. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

presentation.description: Only from a party who is not a member of this community, for an event whose audience names partners: their presentation of the membership credential a named partner issued them (VTI-EVT-132). Verified before, and without reference to, the event; discarded once decided (VTI-EVT-133).

from.description: On a series: expand occurrences still running at or after this instant.

to.description: On a series: expand occurrences starting before this instant; at most 400 days after `from` (VTI-EVT-192).

Response.title: VTC Events — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/show/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/show/0.4#response.

event.description: The event as the caller may see it.

myRegistration.description: The caller's own registration for the event, where they have one, whatever its status.

occurrences.description: On a series asked for with `from` and `to`: its occurrences in that window, earliest first (VTI-EVT-192).
